newsitem.title: UK: BFI down 5, brokers undecided on market direction.
newsitem.headline: BFI down 5, brokers undecided on market direction.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was marked down five points on Thursday to 1,513.
Brokers said the BFI panellists marked all routes marginally down with the exception of US Gulf to Continent and US Gulf to Japan.

Some brokers considered Panamax prospects to be questionable in the Far East and possibly also the North Atlantic but is was generally considered dificult to forecast prospects for April ahead of the holidays.
The Baltic Handy Index was up two to 1,109 in generally steady conditions.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was unchanged to 10 points higher and turnover totalled only 11 lots.
